messages.subject: recap: standup + on-call rotation
messages.body:
Recap of this morning's standup, for those not present:

- app-tier migration follow-ups are closed, all green
- Elena starts today, Jonas is doing her onboarding, first task is the ingest backlog
- on-call: we're starting a weekly rotation next week. Two people, alternating: Jonas one week, Ravi the next. Simple, covers evenings and weekends, escalation to me if it's on fire beyond a P1

I'll send the Pagerly invite and the runbook links before Monday.

Cheers, Dev

messages.subject: RE: recap: standup + on-call rotation
messages.body:
Quick recap of my concern with this:

1. Two people alternating weekly means Jonas and Ravi are effectively never both off the hook - that's a burnout pattern within a quarter
2. In the roadmap review two weeks ago we discussed exactly this, and my understanding was that the rotation would include Greg and Elena once she's onboarded - four people, weekly, is far more sustainable
3. Elena is a senior hire who has done on-call before; not putting her in from month two sets an odd precedent

Happy to be corrected on what was actually agreed, but I don't think two is what we discussed.

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: RE: recap: standup + on-call rotation
messages.body:
two is fine. fwiw.

greg's a contractor, contractors on call is a weird arrangement, who pays him at 3am. and elena started this morning, she shouldn't carry a pager in week one.

if burnout is the worry, pay ravi and me a stipend. cheaper than a meeting about it.

messages.subject: RE: recap: standup + on-call rotation
messages.body:
nobody asked me about on call.

my contract is teh migration + handover to jonas, thats it. not doing weekly rotations, not priced for it either. happy to jump on real incidents while im still around, but thats different from owning a pager.

also 2 people for a 22 person company seems thin but not my call

sent from my phone, sorry for typos

messages.subject: RE: recap: standup + on-call rotation
messages.body:
Hi Dev,

Sorry to bother you about this - I'm definitely okay to be on the rotation, I want to be clear about that. I'd just feel better with a bit more runbook documentation before my first week, since the only incidents I've handled so far were with you or Jonas shadowing. If the rotation could start with Jonas's week that would give me a little more time to write the missing docs.

Sorry again if this is obvious,
Ravi

messages.subject: RE: recap: standup + on-call rotation
messages.body:
Dev, I think we're talking past each other in cc, so let's just settle it properly: can we take 20 minutes in Thursday's product-eng sync and come out with one written rotation - who is in, when it starts, and what Greg is and isn't contracted for? Ravi's runbook point is fair regardless of who ends up on the list.

Thanks!
Priya
